set.body:
Goal
Freeze the successful measurement candidate before reopening the private Wynn retrieval outcomes.

Sequence
Hash code, configuration, folds, candidate sets, thresholds, and environment. Score the exact full 0-3000 ms probe-plus-delay window using four separate equal-prior study episodes and exhaustive candidates. Only after all gaze scores and diagnostics are immutable may response, saliency, old/lure status, and correctness be merged.

Acceptance criteria
- Primary measurement comparison uses common support and identical folds for Transport v3, Transport v2, stabilized Replay, density sigma 80/160, registered density, MultiMatch dimensions, and learned MultiMatch composite.
- Behavioral evidence is judged by out-of-fold log-loss gain and crossed bootstrap uncertainty; GLMM slopes are explanatory diagnostics rather than the sole success criterion.
- The canonical recognition analysis is old-item specific; lure false alarms and graded confidence are declared secondary.
- Generic gaze quality and fixation reliability are entered separately from item-specific gaze_info_bits.
- No algorithm, window, saliency subgroup, or nonlinear form is retuned after outcomes are opened.
- Private CSVs, checkpoints, and trial-level scores remain local and ignored.
- The frozen implementation bundle and manifest are attached by provenance note to GW-10 so the external Wang court can test it without post-data tuning.
set.title: GW-18.10 Freeze Transport v3, then run the full-window retrieval court
